game_concept: A tower defense set in Frost Peaks – Rockfall Chute, a rockfall chute: the rescue climber must handle snow leopards while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Letter Lock: Use string indexing to pull the right letter and crack the lock on the cliff anchor.
theme: Frost Peaks – Rockfall Chute: a rockfall chute
core_gameplay_loop: In Rockfall Chute, repeat each round: Use string indexing to pull the right letter and crack the lock on the cliff anchor. Each round, snow leopards strike the cliff anchor, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the lock_letters value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the cliff anchor from snow leopards in Rockfall Chute: keep the lock_letters meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 51-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: lock_letters drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 51-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 8 (extended tier): Letter Lock
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Letter Lock' (Week 8 slot 1), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Rockfall Chute'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how lock_letters changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against snow leopards in Rockfall Chute.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 51 seconds while lock_letters > 0.
